visualCharacteristics.purpose: Article image set apart from the text flow, with optional caption and optional wrapping text
visualCharacteristics.layout: Centred, floated or aligned article image with caption

contentPattern.structure: one row: cell 1 = picture + optional caption paragraph(s); optional cell 2 = text that wraps beside a left/right figure. Also supports width-<n> and pad-bottom-<n> option classes

usage: Images inside blog, event and news article bodies.
reuseGuidance: Reuse figure for the same content pattern on newly migrated pages; add an option class rather than forking for small visual differences.
